module.title: Document Store for FHIR, Variable Payloads and Versioned Snapshots
module.business_purpose: Stores variable, versioned and externally shaped documents without replacing relational clinical, financial or authorization sources of truth. Every PHI-bearing document carries tenant, patient, classification, encryption, retention and lineage metadata.
